title: Comparing General Journal Entries between Dynamics SL and Dynamics 365 Business Central

chapters.title: General journal entries in Dynamics SL
Navigating Business Central general journal window
Entering auto insurance and interest income entries
Alternative entry methods: grid view and single-line entry
Mass editing journal entries in Excel

features.name: General journal batch management
features.description: Create and define batches for journal entries, with option to set up batches operationally or per user for multiple users entering transactions onto general ledger.

features.name: Account name autocomplete in journal entries
features.description: When entering account numbers, users can start typing the account name and a dropdown will automatically filter results to match.

features.name: Grid view with debit and credit columns
features.description: Alternative view for entering journal entries showing debit and credit amounts in separate columns, providing a different perspective on journal entry data.

features.name: Single-line journal entry
features.description: Efficient method to enter journal entries in a single line with automatic document number generation and offset account functionality for quick entry.

features.name: Excel integration for journal entries
features.description: Users can export journal entries to Excel, make mass changes to multiple lines, and publish changes back to Business Central.
